title: Momentum Ecosystem Initiative Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter shape for an initiative file (initiatives/NNNN-slug.md). The file body is free-form markdown; only the frontmatter block is schema-validated.

id.description: Monotonically-increasing initiative number. Allocated by `momentum ecosystem initiative create`.

slug.description: URL-safe slug used in the filename (NNNN-slug.md) and in session log references.

title.description: Human-readable title. Defaults to slug if not provided.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `closed` requires a non-empty closed date.

closed.description: ISO-8601 date the initiative was closed. Required when status is `closed`.

owner.description: Free-form identifier (GitHub handle, email, or name).

repos.description: Member ids from the ecosystem manifest. Repos contributing to this initiative.

contributions.description:
Per-member work records this initiative fans out to (ADR-0016). Each entry is a flat `member:kind:ref` triple — e.g. `backend:phase:phase-12-attachments`. Written by `momentum ecosystem initiative start`; read by `initiative complete` to locate what must carry Rule 12 evidence before the initiative may close. Optional and additive — initiatives created before Phase 31a validate unchanged.

Deliberately NOT an array of objects: `core/ecosystem/lib/initiative.js` ships a strict, dependency-free frontmatter serializer that flattens arrays via `String(v)`, so nested objects cannot round-trip. Growing a YAML implementation to store three fields would be the wrong trade.

Deliberately carries NO status or evidence field: those are resolved LIVE from each member's own record at completion time. A status the agent wrote into the initiative is exactly the self-reported completion Rule 12 exists to reject.
